verdict.rationale: Temporal documents first-party AI integrations: Google ADK for Python and the Vercel AI SDK for TypeScript. It also documents Serverless Workers on AgentCore Runtime, and its AI solutions page claims orchestration of agents 'across any models, tools, systems.' So LLM and agent steps can live inside code-defined workflows. The evidence is mostly headline-level, and steps are added in code rather than as configurable workflow nodes. Missing for 10: detailed docs on per-step model selection and tool-calling mechanics, examples of agent loops inside workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
